items.description: Sunday of Week 3 features 14 games, including an international game in Rio de Janeiro between the Ravens and Cowboys.

items.headline: NFL Week 3's best arrivals, led by Davante Adams
items.description: NFL stars continue to turn game-day arrivals into their own weekly fashion showcase.

items.headline: C.J. Stroud says winless Texans will get struggles fixed
items.description: C.J. Stroud boldly stated that the winless Texans will turn their season around after a 19-17 loss to the previously winless Colts on Sunday.

items.headline: Injured in warmups, Spencer Shrader rallies Colts with FG
items.description: Indianapolis kicker Spencer Shrader, who sustained a groin injury in warmups, battled through it to make four field goals, including a 53-yarder with 16 seconds left to give the Colts a 19-17 win over the Texans.

items.headline: NFL Week 3: Takeaways, questions, fantasy spin for Sunday's games
items.description: Our NFL Nation reporters react to all the action, answering the biggest questions coming out of each Sunday game. Here's what we learned from Week 3.

items.headline: Colts end 9-game skid with 19-17 victory over Texans as Shrader kicks winner with 16 seconds left
items.description: — The Indianapolis Colts kept talking about turning the page on their season-ending seven-game losing streak that cost them a playoff spot last year.
